claims.statement: Tom Allen said Sullivan lost to Corbett because he was unfit to enter the ring and was overweight.
claims.excerpt: Sullivan was unfit to enter the ring; he was away over-weight and unable to cope with a man of Corbett's agility.

claims.statement: Tom Allen does not recognize Corbett as John L. Sullivan's superior.
claims.excerpt: I don't recognize Corbett as Sullivan's superior.

claims.statement: Tom Allen said Corbett won his fight with Sullivan squarely and deserves credit for it.
claims.excerpt: He won his battle squarely and deserves credit for it

quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: It was all a question of condition

quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: I don't recognize Corbett as Sullivan's superior.

notes: The Sullivan-Corbett fight date (last Wednesday before the article) is 7 September 1892. Kelly's views in the same article are not Allen's and are left out.
